presets.body:
mixed-port: 7890
allow-lan: false
mode: rule
log-level: info
external-controller: 127.0.0.1:9090
dns:
  enable: true
  ipv6: false
  enhanced-mode: fake-ip
  fake-ip-range: 198.18.0.1/16
  nameserver:
    - https://doh.pub/dns-query
    - https://1.0.0.1/dns-query
rules:
  - GEOIP,Private,DIRECT
  - MATCH,Proxy

# 绕过大陆 · 精简版
# 大陆的网站和 IP 直连,其余走代理。不用在线规则集,各种 Clash 内核都能用。
# 节点和 Proxy、Auto 两个策略组由面板自动填进来,这里不用写。
mixed-port: 7890
allow-lan: false
mode: rule
log-level: info
external-controller: 127.0.0.1:9090
dns:
  enable: true
  ipv6: false
  enhanced-mode: fake-ip
  fake-ip-range: 198.18.0.1/16
  fake-ip-filter:
    - "*.lan"
    - "*.local"
    - "+.msftconnecttest.com"
    - "+.msftncsi.com"
    - "time.*.com"
    - "ntp.*.com"
    - "+.pool.ntp.org"
  default-nameserver:
    - 223.5.5.5
    - 119.29.29.29
  # 普通 DNS(国内两家公共解析)。想用加密的 DoH,把下面两行换成:
  #   - https://doh.pub/dns-query
  #   - https://dns.alidns.com/dns-query
  nameserver:
    - 223.5.5.5
    - 119.29.29.29
rules:
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,local,DIRECT
  - IP-CIDR,127.0.0.0/8,DIRECT,no-resolve
  - IP-CIDR,10.0.0.0/8,DIRECT,no-resolve
  - IP-CIDR,172.16.0.0/12,DIRECT,no-resolve
  - IP-CIDR,192.168.0.0/16,DIRECT,no-resolve
  - IP-CIDR,100.64.0.0/10,DIRECT,no-resolve
  - IP-CIDR,169.254.0.0/16,DIRECT,no-resolve
  - IP-CIDR6,::1/128,DIRECT,no-resolve
  - IP-CIDR6,fc00::/7,DIRECT,no-resolve
  - IP-CIDR6,fe80::/10,DIRECT,no-resolve
  - DOMAIN-SUFFIX,cn,DIRECT
  - GEOIP,CN,DIRECT
  - MATCH,Proxy

# 绕过大陆 · 规则集版(要 mihomo 内核:Clash Verge Rev、FlClash、Clash Meta for Android、Mihomo Party 等)
# 大陆的域名和 IP 直连;被屏蔽的、境外的域名直接交给代理,不在本地解析。
# 规则集来自 MetaCubeX/meta-rules-dat,经代理下载,每天更新一次。
# 节点和 Proxy、Auto 两个策略组由面板自动填进来,这里不用写。
mixed-port: 7890
allow-lan: false
mode: rule
log-level: info
external-controller: 127.0.0.1:9090
dns:
  enable: true
  ipv6: false
  enhanced-mode: fake-ip
  fake-ip-range: 198.18.0.1/16
  fake-ip-filter:
    - "*.lan"
    - "*.local"
    - "+.msftconnecttest.com"
    - "+.msftncsi.com"
    - "time.*.com"
    - "ntp.*.com"
    - "+.pool.ntp.org"
  default-nameserver:
    - 223.5.5.5
    - 119.29.29.29
  # 普通 DNS(国内两家公共解析)。想用加密的 DoH,把下面两行换成:
  #   - https://doh.pub/dns-query
  #   - https://dns.alidns.com/dns-query
  nameserver:
    - 223.5.5.5
    - 119.29.29.29
rule-providers:
  private: {type: http, behavior: domain, format: mrs, interval: 86400, proxy: Proxy, url: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/MetaCubeX/meta-rules-dat@meta/geo/geosite/private.mrs"}
  gfw: {type: http, behavior: domain, format: mrs, interval: 86400, proxy: Proxy, url: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/MetaCubeX/meta-rules-dat@meta/geo/geosite/gfw.mrs"}
  cn: {type: http, behavior: domain, format: mrs, interval: 86400, proxy: Proxy, url: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/MetaCubeX/meta-rules-dat@meta/geo/geosite/cn.mrs"}
  global: {type: http, behavior: domain, format: mrs, interval: 86400, proxy: Proxy, url: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/MetaCubeX/meta-rules-dat@meta/geo/geosite/geolocation-!cn.mrs"}
  private-ip: {type: http, behavior: ipcidr, format: mrs, interval: 86400, proxy: Proxy, url: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/MetaCubeX/meta-rules-dat@meta/geo/geoip/private.mrs"}
  cn-ip: {type: http, behavior: ipcidr, format: mrs, interval: 86400, proxy: Proxy, url: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/MetaCubeX/meta-rules-dat@meta/geo/geoip/cn.mrs"}
rules:
  - RULE-SET,private,DIRECT
  - RULE-SET,private-ip,DIRECT,no-resolve
  - RULE-SET,gfw,Proxy
  - RULE-SET,cn,DIRECT
  - RULE-SET,global,Proxy
  - RULE-SET,cn-ip,DIRECT
  - MATCH,Proxy

# 只代理被屏蔽的 · 规则集版(要 mihomo 内核:Clash Verge Rev、FlClash、Clash Meta for Android、Mihomo Party 等)
